import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000009;
    static int source, sink;
    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> G;
    static ArrayList<Edge> e;
    static int[] ptr = new int[1001];
    static int[] dist = new int[1001];
    static String[] scientists = new String[101];
    static String[] reactors = new String[101];
    static boolean[][][][] isReachable = new boolean[10][10][10][10]; // unused
    static int[][] becomesUnusableAt = new int[10][10];
    static int n, m;
    static boolean[][] visited = new boolean[101][101];

    static class Edge {
        int u, v, flow, capacity;
        Edge(int u, int v, int flow, int capacity) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
        }
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int capacity) {
        G.get(u).add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, capacity));
        G.get(v).add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
    }

    static boolean findPath() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
        dist[source] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        Q.add(source);
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = Q.poll();
            for (int id : G.get(u)) {
                int v = e.get(id).v;
                if (dist[v] == -1 && e.get(id).flow < e.get(id).capacity) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    Q.add(v);
                    if (v == sink) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static long sendFlow(int u, int flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return 0;
        if (u == sink) return flow;
        for (; ptr[u] < G.get(u).size(); ++ptr[u]) {
            int id = G.get(u).get(ptr[u]);
            int v = e.get(id).v;
            if (dist[v] != dist[u] + 1) continue;
            long pushed = sendFlow(v, Math.min(flow, e.get(id).capacity - e.get(id).flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.get(id).flow += pushed;
                e.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static long dinics() {
        long flow = 0;
        while (findPath()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            long pushed;
            while ((pushed = sendFlow(source, INF)) > 0) {
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static boolean isValid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < n && c < m;
    }

    static int getID(int x, int y) {
        return 1 + m * x + y;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        int T = scanner.nextInt();
        T++;
        m = n;
        sink = m * m + m * m + 1;
        source = 0;
        G = new ArrayList<>(m * m * 2 + 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < m * m * 2 + 2; i++) {
            G.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        e = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(becomesUnusableAt[i], INF);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            scientists[i] = scanner.next();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            reactors[i] = scanner.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                if (reactors[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    becomesUnusableAt[i][j] = 1;
                    Queue<int[]> Q = new LinkedList<>();
                    Q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] p = Q.poll();
                        int x = p[0], y = p[1];
                        for (int di = -1; di <= 1; di++) {
                            for (int dj = -1; dj <= 1; dj++) {
                                if (Math.abs(di) + Math.abs(dj) == 1) {
                                    int nx = x + di;
                                    int ny = y + dj;
                                    if (isValid(nx, ny) && becomesUnusableAt[nx][ny] == INF && scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y') {
                                        becomesUnusableAt[nx][ny] = becomesUnusableAt[x][y] + 1;
                                        Q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Build graph
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < m; y++) {
                char sc = scientists[x].charAt(y);
                if (sc >= '1' && sc <= '9') {
                    addEdge(source, getID(x, y), sc - '0');
                }
                char rc = reactors[x].charAt(y);
                if (rc >= '1' && rc <= '9') {
                    addEdge(n * n + getID(x, y), sink, rc - '0');
                }
                for (int X = 0; X < n; X++) {
                    for (int Y = 0; Y < m; Y++) {
                        char sc2 = scientists[X].charAt(Y);
                        char rc2 = reactors[X].charAt(Y);
                        if (sc == 'Y' || sc == 'Z' || rc2 == 'Y' || rc2 == 'Z') continue;

                        // Reset visited
                        for (int i = 0; i < 101; i++) Arrays.fill(visited[i], false);
                        Queue<int[]> Q = new LinkedList<>();
                        Q.add(new int[]{x, y, 1});
                        visited[x][y] = true;
                        boolean found = false;
                        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                            int[] p = Q.poll();
                            int cx = p[0], cy = p[1], tim = p[2];
                            if (cx == X && cy == Y) {
                                visited[cx][cy] = true;
                                found = true;
                                break;
                            }
                            if (tim >= becomesUnusableAt[cx][cy] || tim >= T) continue;
                            for (int di = -1; di <= 1; di++) {
                                for (int dj = -1; dj <= 1; dj++) {
                                    if (Math.abs(di) + Math.abs(dj) == 1) {
                                        int nx = cx + di, ny = cy + dj;
                                        if (isValid(nx, ny) && !visited[nx][ny] && scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Z' && tim + 1 <= becomesUnusableAt[nx][ny]) {
                                            visited[nx][ny] = true;
                                            Q.add(new int[]{nx, ny, tim + 1});
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (visited[X][Y]) {
                            addEdge(getID(x, y), n * n + getID(X, Y), INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long ans = dinics();
        System.out.println(ans);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
